newsitem.title: USA: Industrial Development to offer shares.
newsitem.headline: Industrial Development to offer shares.

text.p: The Industrial Development Bank of India will offer shares of its commercial bank unit in an initial public offering within the next 12 months, Chief General Manager P.S. Subramanyam said on Monday.
Speaking at the Jardine Fleming Asia Conference in New York, Subramanyam said, "We will initially go in for a domestic offering. Afterward, (we) may do offshore."
Commenting on IDBI's long-term growth he said "We expect to maintain return on equity (ROE) at around 20 percent in coming years and asset growth of around 15 percent."

He said the bank will be paying greater attention to infrastructure projects in the future, particularly in the power and telecommunication sectors. However, he said, it was waiting for the government to create clearer guidelines on such infrastructure projects.
He identified the insurance sector as another area where the bank plans to play a role once regulatory constraints have been lifted.
He said the bank's strategy is to increase sea-based income as the Indian market opens up.
IDBI is India's largest long-term lending institution with 31 percent of all loan disbursements.
